# Warming Up Visitors

## Description

Visitors who browsed lightly a few weeks ago and are browsing a lot more now, tagged and flagged to growth as an escalating-interest signal worth a closer look.

## Steps

### Step 1: Build the warming-up visitor list

Build a segment of users named "Warming Up Visitors". A user is in the segment only when all of these are true: triggered "View page" at least once between 14 and 30 days ago; triggered "View page" at least 3 times in the last 7 days.

### Step 2: Tag the matched visitors

Create an attribute named "warming_up" on users in "Warming Up Visitors", set to true. Use the result of "Build the warming-up visitor list".

### Step 3: Alert growth

Generate a Slack message to the growth team channel. Say how many users are in "Warming Up Visitors" right now, so the team has a ready-made shortlist of visitors trending toward higher engagement. Use the result of "Build the warming-up visitor list".
